ground.notes: ENV-U10 themed ground (tools/art/env_kit/ground_splat.py, ground-params.json): runtime = four /Engine/BasicShapes/Plane strips = tray top minus the frame (hole = frame outer - frameOverlapUU, outer = tray top - insetUU) at z, NoCollision, no shadow casting; material MI_EnvGround_<Map> (tools/art/env_kit/ue_import_env_ground.py) gets GroundStrip / SplatRect per strip (MID); the aux mask (water / foam / edge band / depth) is bound in the MI. P4 waterfalls (S08EnvGround): per entry a vertical engine-plane card x0..x1 at y from topZ down dropUU plus a flat spill (y - spillUU .. y at topZ) over the T2 lip, MI_EnvWaterfall_<Map>, no collision, no shadow.

notes: Sarpedon - concept v2 (ENV-U8): NW fort ruin with a campfire in front, palisade = 2 segments along the far edge right of the fort (facing the camera) + 3 along the W side turned 15-20 deg towards the camera (edge-on they read as a thin line), trees W/NW behind the palisade, a fire basket (Campfire) in the W palisade gap. E: ship hull as 2 sections at scale 0.85 (255 long x 218 h; the processed hull is 300 long x 256 h - its proportions incl. the rigging, not the ~130 h of the proposal), on a slight curve (UE yaw 152 -> 165, bow towards the far-right corner) with the outboard red side and gunports facing the map and the camera; 4 cannons (1.4 -> 63 long; 45 is a speck next to 50-uu heroes) in front of the hull pointing at the map; rope coils (1.8 -> 40 dia) NE and SE. Far centre (river mouth / beach, X ~ -300..+400) and the near edge where the river leaves the map (X ~ -45..+90, waterfall over the tray edge) are kept free for a later water VFX - no prop. 18 props, 4 warm lights (2 campfires + 2 ship lanterns on the hull rail; the lantern mesh is pending, SM_Decor_Lantern is not in this worktree); leaves 2 points for a cool moon/water fill. Conventions: board-actor space (origin = map centre, +X right on the K1 screen, +Y towards the K1 camera = near side, Z up, map plane ~0); props stand on the tray top z -3, pivot = base centre; yawDeg = UE actor yaw of the processed UM_FBX_v1 mesh (tools/art/env_kit/env_kit_build.py: local +X = FRONT = the Tripo 'front' reference view, Y = width, Z = up), so 90 turns the front to the K1 camera (+Y) with the width along X, 180 faces -X/west, 0 faces +X/east, -90 faces -Y/far; scale multiplies the processed mesh, whose size already equals its target (height; Hull/Cannon = length, Campfire/Rope = diameter = longest horizontal extent; e.g. Hull 300 x 64 x 256, Cannon 45 x 32 x 27). Tray (ENV-U10 / 'одна каменная подложка', T2): the ONE shared stone tray SM_TableBase_T2 of both map boards - halfX 780 x halfY 470 centred at (0, offsetY -45) (negative = towards the far side), flat top z -3, placed at scale 1 (no stretch; T1 SM_TableBase stays for the grid fixtures) = frame outer rectangle (|X| <= 469.667, |Y| <= 312.667) + apron n 202.33 / s 112.33 / w = e 310.33 (the apron follows the shared tray, art/pipeline-candidates/ASSET-TABLE-BASE-001/20261001-tray-t2/reports/tray-t2-params.json); its rocky lip may rise to z +2 only within rimUU 20 of the tray edge (keep prop bases out of that band). The near band (Y > 312.667, |X| < 469.667, between the map and the camera) is kept empty; tall props only on the far side and in the far halves of W/E. Checked by tools/art/env_kit/layout_check.py: no prop box covers or comes within 4 px (1080p) of any space circle at K1 (D0 = 2340 uu = the fit 1872 uu x k1DistanceMul 1.25 of the board profile, ENV-U9) and every wheel zoom (0.8125x .. 7.80x of D0: notches of x1.25 clamped to 300 uu .. fit/0.65 = 2880 uu) plus 1.2x/1.6x of D0, looking at the centre and, from 1.2x of D0 on, following every space; no castShadow prop's key-light (-55, 30, 0) shadow touches a circle.
